description: Source file implementing global socket management for wpaCtrl, including context fetching, initialization, connection handling, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: s_fetchGSockByData
methods.description: Fetches a global socket context matching a provided context pointer.

methods.name: s_fetchGSockByName
methods.description: Fetches a global socket context matching a provided socket name.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_checkByGName
methods.description: Checks if a global socket context exists for a given name.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_fetchByGName
methods.description: Fetches a global socket context by name.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_getGName
methods.description: Returns the socket name of a global socket context.

methods.name: s_fetchGSockByPath
methods.description: Fetches a global socket context matching a socket path.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_fetchByGPath
methods.description: Fetches a global socket context by socket path.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_checkByGPath
methods.description: Checks if a global socket context exists for a given path.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_fetchGPathInDmnArgs
methods.description: Parses security daemon args to find the global socket path argument '-g'.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_checkGPathInDmnArgs
methods.description: Checks if a global socket path is indicated in the daemon args.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_getGIface
methods.description: Returns the wpactrl interface of a global socket context.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_getGIfacePath
methods.description: Returns the server path of the wpactrl interface.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_getGMgr
methods.description: Returns the wpactrl manager of a global socket context.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and frees a global socket context.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_setServerPath
methods.description: Sets the server path for a global socket context.

methods.name: s_initGSock
methods.description: Initializes a global socket context, linking to security daemon or group, optionally setting server path.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_initWithSecDmn
methods.description: Initializes a global socket context for a standalone security daemon.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_initWithSecDmnGrp
methods.description: Initializes a global socket context for a security daemon group.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the global socket interface is available (socket file exists).

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_isReady
methods.description: Checks if the global socket manager is ready (connected).

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the global socket interface is connected.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_isConnecting
methods.description: Checks if the global socket interface is in the process of connecting.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_connect
methods.description: Starts connecting the global socket interface to the server.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_stopConnecting
methods.description: Stops the connection attempt.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the global socket interface.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_countUsers
methods.description: Counts active users (secDmn or group members) subscribed to the socket.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlGSock_disconnectIfUnused
methods.description: Disconnects the socket if no active users are subscribed.
